name: Oracle
body:
Alignment: Any

Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s oracle class levels learns all oracle spells their mentor knows, adding them to their list of spells known for the day. The apprentice casts spells learned from a oracle mentor as divine spells. Spells cast this way use the apprentice’s Charisma regardless of what ability their mentor uses to modify their spells. This ability does not allow an apprentice to cast spell they cannot learn due to their Charisma score or level. Apprentices treat spells learned this way just as any other spontaneous spell caster would their spells known. Your caster level is equal to your apprentice level, and your save DCs and concentration checks are Charisma-based. You’re considered to have the cleric/oracle spell list for purposes of spell completion items and spell trigger items.

Advanced Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s oracle class levels and chooses oracle for their advanced mentorship ability for the day gains the oracle‘s mystery class feature. The apprentice must select the same mystery as his mentor. The apprentice gains one revelation from his mystery for every four apprentice levels he possesses. When determining the effects of the apprentice’s revelations, the apprentice’s effective oracle level is equal to his apprentice level minus 3. The apprentice adds all mystery spells he can cast to his list of spells known. The apprentice doesn’t gain any additional class skills from his mystery.

Cooperation Power

Key ability: Charisma

Apprentices who study a mentor’s oracle class levels and chooses oracle for their cooperation power may spend a cooperation point as a standard action to grant himself or an ally an oracle’s curse for the next minute. This curse must be the same curse your mentor possesses. The cursed creature treats all levels they possess as oracle levels for determining the effects of the oracle‘s curse. Choosing this cooperation power counts as gaining the oracle’s curse class feature for the purposes of the apprentice’s approximate expertise class feature but you must have the oracle cooperation power to benefit from a feat whose prerequisites were met in this manner.
